senses.gloss: or הוֹרָה f. (denom. of Hofal of הָרָה) conception, being conceived.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 58a:1">Snh. 58ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>הוֹרָתוֹ שלא בקרושה</he> he was conceived in an unhallowed condition (when his mother was a gentile).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:20">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> <he>הוֹרָתָהּ בדרך</he> she was conceived on the road.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:20">Ib.</cite> <he>מה הורתה שלא בצער</he> as she conceived without pain; a. fr.
